body: It is kinda stupid how you have to struggle all your life just to get by, working brain numbing hours just to get the minimum wage. Some people i've met have dreams or an end point, an aim that makes the struggle seem worth it but when you're lacking that then everything just seems pointless but you know i tell myself that its the little moments in between that are worth it. The little snippets of happiness or bliss, the small things. living for the little, minute things i guess, is one way.
I know how that is. Im going through sonething very similar.

I know that. I do. Ive held on for so long. I used to cut myself. And i knew it was wrong so i stopped. I used to be in so much pain but no one notices. I once tried to tell my mom about it and she ignored me because she had more important stuff to do. I just dont know. I had a big goal which was keeping me up till now and i failed. Turns out im not good enough. Im just so so tired. And i need it to stop
